author: kikichu44
quote: Quite disappointing for GTA franchise. It's turned into a dating simulation rather than a crime game like before. FPS drops, bugs,glitches gave me headache. I don't like Lucia or Jason's personality. The story is not fun at all. Missions feel like side missions like doing chores for Lucia. Lucia even abandoned his son and that made me hate her. Jason is a simp. That makes the most worst protagonists I've ever played with. Never expected this from Rockstar. Not worth waiting 13 years and even $80. I don't even want to continue this game but whatever I payed for this game. I don't even know how this game got nominated. RIP Rockstar. Goodbye GTA.
